verdict.rationale: Temporal supports code-based workflow definitions (Workflows-as-Code) that live in normal source control by nature, and Worker Versioning lets teams roll out new code paths gradually while old executions keep running, which functions as a promotion mechanism from dev to prod. However there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated dev-to-prod environment promotion pipeline, CI/CD integration, or governance workflow for versioning approvals. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or environment-promotion tooling docs, first-party guidance on git-based workflow versioning practices, independent/hands-on confirmation of the versioning rollout process working smoothly in production.
